title: Giant Texture Path
description: The giant now has its own separate texture path from the zombie, making it customizable!
body:
## Note: 
This is an extra feature from a larger mod of mine for 1.21.1, which is still in development, but I decided to bring it to 1.20.1.

This mod gives the Giant its own independent texture path from the Zombie, allowing you to customize its texture separately. You may find it useful for adventure maps or minigames, or even combine it with [Giant Spawn](https://modrinth.com/mod/giant-spawn).

Example:

![Giant with a 32x32 texture](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/15fb0d71bbd945b79a47f303d0c96f0684e051aa.png)

## Resourcepack:

You can edit the texture using a resource pack by following this path-> assets/gianttexturepath/textures/entity/giant.png

Feel completely free to use it in any modpack.
